# Hairstyle Try On

Hairstyle try on: see a new haircut or hair color on your own photo from your MegaScenes library before the salon, with the same face: a bob, bangs, a buzz cut, waves or a new shade.

## What it does
Pick a photo of yourself from your MegaScenes library and name the cut or the color. Claude tells you the price and shows you with the new hair, keeping your face.

**How the files are made:** each hairstyle try-on is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Only your own photo or one of someone who agreed, never a famous person.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install hairstyle-try-on@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Hairstyle Try On talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/hairstyle/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each hairstyle try-on uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The hairstyle try-ons show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_hairstyle_models` | Models for hairstyle try-ons with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_hairstyle_cost` | Exact price of one hairstyle try-on before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_hairstyle` | Starts one hairstyle try-on in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_hairstyle` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Try a short bob on my latest MegaScenes selfie"
- "Show me with copper red hair"
- "Give me curtain bangs and long waves"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the hairstyle try-on (the photo you pick from your library and the hairstyle and color) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
